_doc: noise4: the C5 inverter's K3 budget at the injected (measured) noise level, the owner's decision of 2026-11-25. Development values, not preregistered. The gate's K3 allowance is K3_sigmas x sigma: delta = 3 sigma_delta_x, eta = 3 sigma_eta_x, each rounded up to the gate's rational_denominator (1e6), as invinst/gate.py allowance() rounds. Each sigma is the LARGER of two measures (the owner's rule), from two noisy NOT1 runs of dev seed 9801 with two noise seeds, by tests/check_noise_sources.py: round 1, noise seed 98011 (controls4, dev/controls4/not1_N1a/noise_sources.json, pushed at ee58b78) and round 4, noise seed 98014 (controls5 save_ref=1, dev/controls5/seed2_N4/noise_sources.json). The R cells' noise is unchanged (noise2's sources, campaign (a)'s convention). research/circuit/noise.json is unchanged.

sigma_delta.source: the larger of the two measures (noise seed 98011): rms of xn0.nzm over the run, read at the source's sample instants k tnz (6501 samples over 2.6 ms)

sigma_eta.source: the larger of the two measures (noise seed 98011): sd of the mirror charge integral of (nzh + nzj) over 130 disjoint windows of length D tu = 20 us, divided by cq vunit
sigma_eta.replaces: sqrt(2) inmw sqrt(D tu tnz) / (cq vunit) = 0.0007843264626416732 (D 1, tu 2e-5 s, tnz 4e-7 s, cq 5e-12 F)
